title.zh: 时间序列与 iAUC 插图

provenance.zh: 均值和误差人工估读；iAUC 散点为固定种子的示例数据
provenance.en: Time-course means and errors were visually estimated. Inset observations are seeded synthetic examples.

seed_note: Original example-generation session used NumPy seed 190913 across all figures; the seed alone does not reconstruct digitized/manual values. The committed CSVs and SHA-256 hashes define this snapshot.

zh: 每只动物在每个 day 的体重、基线体重、处理组及个体 ID；保留纵向配对关系。
体重变化百分比公式、Exposure/Cessation 的时间窗与 iAUC 积分及基线定义。
每个个体的 iAUC、组均值、指定的 SD/SEM/CI 及原始统计检验。
en: Weight, baseline weight, treatment and subject ID for each animal/day, preserving longitudinal pairing.
Weight-change formula, Exposure/Cessation windows, and the iAUC integration and baseline definitions.
Individual iAUC values, group means, the specified SD/SEM/CI and original statistical tests.

preprocessing.zh: 时序 CSV 直接接收 mean/error；iAUC 必须按个体轨迹另行计算后写入辅助表，代码不会从均值曲线求个体 iAUC。
preprocessing.en: The time-course CSV accepts mean/error. Calculate individual iAUC upstream and supply the inset table; the code does not infer individual iAUC from mean curves.
